AWAKENED.SettingDefault: Use the Awakened Dreaming sheet by default
AWAKENED.SettingDefaultHint: New and existing player characters open with the Awakened Dreaming sheet unless a different sheet was picked for them in Sheet Configuration. Requires a reload.
AWAKENED.SettingTitleHint: The banner text at the top of every character sheet.
AWAKENED.MissingSystem: Awakened Dreaming sheet: the Cypher System's PC sheet could not be found, so the custom sheet was not registered. Check that the Cypher System is up to date.
AWAKENED.EffortHint: Your Effort limit equals your Tier. Click a diamond to spend it; the Long Rest restores it.
AWAKENED.UnawakenedHint: Unawakened characters have no aura or bleed-through.
AWAKENED.MorphsHint: Each attempt costs 2 XP. The first attempt is difficulty 6 and every later attempt is eased by 1. Three successes make the morph permanent. The morphed ability is added alongside the original at 1.5x its cost, rounded up.
AWAKENED.MorphDone: Permanent. Add the morphed ability on the Abilities tab.
AWAKENED.MorphNoXP: {name} needs at least {xp} XP for a morph attempt.
AWAKENED.MorphNeedAbilities: Add abilities on the Abilities tab first.
AWAKENED.SettingBulansHint: Renames cyphers to Bulans in the Cypher System's labels (sheets, item types, chat). Requires a reload.
AWAKENED.RecoveryDiceHint: Recovery dice (number of dice, die size, bonus)
AWAKENED.AwakeningsHint: Each new Awakening brings its own aura, bleed-through and focus. That focus has its own tiers and reduced benefits (no extra Effort). Bleed-through worsens as Tier rises. Up to six Awakenings.
AWAKENED.SplitCostHint: Enter the points this ability takes from each pool. Leave a pool at 0 if the ability doesn't use it. Edge applies to each pool separately.
AWAKENED.StackAdd: Add to a stacked action (costs are totalled before Edge)
AWAKENED.StackTip: Using several abilities in one action? Click the stack icon on each one. Their costs are added up per pool, then Edge comes off each pool's total once.
AWAKENED.StackSkipped: Not included (XP cost, or no pool chosen): {names}
AWAKENED.StackSkippedShort: Not included (XP cost, or no pool chosen):
AWAKENED.ChoosePoolText: {name} costs {cost} points from any pool. Which pool should it draw from in this stacked action?
AWAKENED.SettingXPFallbackHint: When paying for an ability would take a pool below 0, the pool drops to 0 and the missing points are paid with XP (the sheet asks first).
AWAKENED.SettingXPRateHint: How much XP covers one missing pool point.
AWAKENED.XPCoverText: {name} is short {short}. Spend {xp} XP to cover it? The pool drops to 0. ({name} has {have} XP.)
AWAKENED.XPNotEnough: {name} is short {short} and would need {xp} XP to cover it, but only has {have} XP.
AWAKENED.StackXP: Not enough in a pool. Paying will drop it to 0 and spend
AWAKENED.StackShort: Not enough points in a pool to pay for this.
